samplingAdequacyPolicy.meaning: Observation adequacy only; no mathematical memory or growth bound is inferred.

oomEvidenceMeaning: Samples with positive Docker/cgroup OOM evidence; repeated cumulative counters are not distinct OOM events.

unattributedSignalExits.meaning: Signal termination without positive OOM attribution; this does not establish successful completion.

interpretation: Each process lifetime is separate. Cgroup peak is container-lifetime high water and can include an earlier process. Two-second sampled maxima and window slopes require human curve review; no threshold certifies a memory bound, non-accelerating growth, or absence of transient peaks/an asymptotic leak.
